definitions: A surname of noble origin, notably associated with the Coudenhove-Kalergi family.
Richard von Coudenhove-Kalergi (1894-1972), an Austrian-Japanese politician, philosopher, and count, considered the founder of the Pan-European Union.
examples: The Coudenhove-Kalergi family has a rich history.
Richard von Coudenhove-Kalergi advocated for a united Europe.
